summary: BioLineRx Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, along with a corporate update. The filing includes a press release, interim financial statements, and an operating and financial review. The company reported $13.1 million cash and provided pipeline updates on GLIX1. It also disclosed a definitive agreement for an offering with gross proceeds of $3.75 million, expected to close on August 31, 2026. No special-situation corporate event (merger, tender, spin-off, etc.) is present; this is a routine earnings and capital-raising disclosure.
